thread:
Alex: Quick q — customer Acme is pushing for personalized checkout prompts. RICE for experiment vs ship-only are pretty close. Do we run an A/B or just ship?
Sam: I'd lean experiment first unless it's a hard contract. RICE rough: Impact 7, Reach 6, Confidence 6, Effort 3 => RICE ~84. Shipping without experiment looks riskier for quality.
Maria: Customer is threatening to move if we don't deliver a fix within 72h. Can we do canary+experiment so they get the change but we still gather signal?
Dinesh: Infra note — per-user prompt caches increase memory pressure. Need fallback to global prompt if KV cache grows. Also define alert thresholds before wide rollout.
Jin: Proposed rollout tiles + gates:
```
- 0->1% (canary) monitor latency, errors, quality signal
- 1->10% if error_rate < 0.3% and p95_latency < 500ms
- 10->100% if eval_delta_loss < 0.02 and conversion uplift > 1.5%
Abort if CPU > 75% OR model error spikes > 0.5%
Canary timeout: 1h default (manual override allowed)
```
Rachel: Add eval set `checkout_flow_v2` and require a manual QA pass at the 10% gate. Also include a small human review sample (10 sessions) for semantic regressions.
Alex: Need clear launch criteria owners: product owns metric targets, eng owns infra gates, SRE owns alerts/runbook. Metrics: conv_rate, avg_order_value, latency_p95, error_rate.
Sam: I'll draft the gating table + RICE calc and tag owners. Suggest automatic fallback: route to previous model variant + route limiting to dedicated pool if things degrade.
deploy-bot: deploy started for feature/exp-acme at 1867004389 :rocket:
Dinesh: Confirmed — I'll add runbook lines: who to page (oncall + product lead), how to trigger rollback, and how to revert traffic split. Also instrument KV cache metrics.
Maria: If we can get canary live within 48h the customer will accept. We need to keep them informed w/ checkpoints. :thumbsup: 
Alex: Okay — Sam, please open PR with the gating thresholds, the RICE spreadsheet, and owners. Also include the experiment id so we can tie evals.
Sam: Will do, PR: https://git.internal/redwood/exp/123 and I'll ping once ready.
